ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when value of status is not changed from "In Progress" , " On Hold –Internal" and "On Hold –Customer" to "Resolved" .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISCHANGED( Status ) ,NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "In Progress") ,ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "On Hold - Internal") , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "On Hold - Customer") )), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Resolved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Resolved can be changed from In Progress , On Hold - Internal and On Hold - Customer.
